name: Penn 3T–7T Paired Epilepsy Imaging

cohort.types: drug-resistant focal epilepsy (Methods: temporal lobe epilepsy); Engel I 11, II–IV 4

modalities: 3T and 7T T1w (MPRAGE/MP2RAGE), T2w, FLAIR, resting-state fMRI (7–9 min, TR 0.5–1 s); iEEG ECoG/SEEG at 500/512/1024 Hz; post-implant CT
format: BIDS sourcedata (NIfTI); derivatives fmriprep3T/7T, freesurfer3T/7T, ieeg-recon
labels: Ictal epochs picked from clinical notes; electrode localisation; SOZ labelling not described
outcomes: Engel class in metadata (15 with outcome in Table 1)
caveats: Possible overlap with PennEPI and ds004100
checks: Pennsieve file tree walked (derivatives per subject, sourcedata sessions); full text PMC13582879. The Pennsieve page cites the Pennsieve platform paper (10.1038/s41597-025-06075-5), not a second dataset paper.
pipeline: High-field anatomy and fMRI functional connectivity for fitting/validating network models against iEEG in the same patients.
key_claim: 30 patients with paired 3T/7T structural and resting-state fMRI plus iEEG and electrode maps; no DWI.

evidence.quote: We present a multimodal paired 3T and 7T MRI dataset acquired from 30 drug-resistant focal epilepsy patients (18 females, 38.8 ± 11.7 years)
